name: template-creator
description: Create and update personal templates from files, Google Docs, Slides, and Sheets links, ImageGen or Product Design images, emails, Slack messages, and Site projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create or update reusable templates from reference content
interface.longDescription: Use Template Creator to create reusable templates from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, Google Docs, Slides, and Sheets links, ImageGen or Product Design images, emails, Slack messages, and Site projects. Template Creator preserves the structure, voice, layout, and style of your reference so you can quickly create new versions whenever you need them.
defaultPrompt: Create a reusable template from a document, presentation, spreadsheet, Google Workspace link, or Site project
Turn this ImageGen or Product Design image into a reusable template
Save this email or Slack message as a reusable text template
